name: kilo-mcp-image-patch
description: Patches the Kilo Code chat webview so MCP tool results (read_image, browser screenshots) render image attachments inline, one per row with its path.

commands.title: Kilo MCP Image Patch: Apply / Re-apply
Kilo MCP Image Patch: Remove (restore original)
Kilo MCP Image Patch: Open Menu

kiloMcpImagePatch.autoApply.description: Automatically apply the patch on startup and after a Kilo Code update replaces the webview. When off, you will be asked before applying.

kiloMcpImagePatch.showStatusBar.description: Show a status bar indicator for the patch state.
